front: What questions is handheld/POCUS echo best suited to answer?
back: Targeted binary questions: pericardial effusion (yes/no), gross LV function (normal/reduced/severely reduced), IVC size and collapsibility, gross valve pathology screen.

front: Can a handheld echo replace a comprehensive TTE?
back: No. POCUS complements but does not replace a full study — it is limited in modes, views, and quantitative measurement capability.
